newsitem.title: USA: California Micro sees $0.01 EPS in Q3.
newsitem.headline: California Micro sees $0.01 EPS in Q3.

text.p: California Micro Devices Corp said it expects to report third quarter earnings per share of about $0.01.
It said that figure would include a small one-time gain.
In the year ago third quarter, the company reported earnings of $2.7 million or $0.24 per share.
The company said it had expected some fall-off of sales in Taiwanese markets because of weaker personal computer sales there, but "the magnitude of the decline was not anticipated."
The company also said it sustained a "strong sequential increase in bookings, resulting in about a 1.1 to 1.0 book to bill ratio for the quarter."
In addition, it said the decline in sales in Taiwan was partly offset by an increase in sales in the U.S.
The forecast $0.01 per share profit compares with a consensus estimate of $0.02.
